Name: OniiOne's Curvy Abigail Mod for 1.5
Author: deleted119193213
Description:
OniiOne's (awesome) Curvy Abigail Mod updated to SDV 1.5, adding missing sprites on the main spritesheet and including beach portraits (adapted
from those of the original author) and newly made beach sprites. I'm just a casual modder and by no means a pixel artist, but I hope to have done a good job in keeping this mod up to date and bringing our beloved purple-haired girl to the beaches of Ginger Island in all of her pear-fect shape. Enjoy!

OniiOne's original Curvy Abigail Mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/907﻿]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/907
[/url]
NB: I should have predicted that people would complain about the "Curvy" in the title, arguing that it's not curvy, it's fat. And, yeah, this is [i]definitely [/i]a fat Abigail mod, although the curvy part is not at all absent. I mean, just look at her belly... But, since this is an adaptation of an earlier mod, I decided to keep the original title.
